description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something. Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. It will allow us to do the things we love in ways never before possible — all while staying connected to the people around us.

Description
Your responsibilities will include creating sample apps to test API, creating Test automation framework and API testing. As a Tools & Automation Engineer, you will help with developing and maintaining automated test suites for exercising various features of visionOS spatial compute applications and continuously look for ways to improve and enhance system reliability and performance. Use approved AI coding assistants to write, review, and maintain automated tests. Own the correctness of the result by checking for weak assertions, hallucinated APIs, and flaky behavior. It will also include functional testing of new features on visionOS, design and implementation of test plans and test cases, risk analysis, prioritizing and escalating critical bugs, and integration testing across Apple platforms. You will be responsible for setting the bar high within your own areas of expertise and frequently collaborating with team members beyond your areas to ensure we ship the superb end-to-end experiences necessary for robust and amazing products.

Responsibilities
Creating sample apps to test API, creating Test automation framework and API testing. Use approved AI coding assistants to write, review, and maintain automated tests. Own the correctness of the result by checking for weak assertions, hallucinated APIs, and flaky behavior.
Extensive knowledge in creating Test Framework, creating sample test apps for API testing. Writing test cases for code coverage. 
Uses LLM coding assistants to write, review, and refactor test code. Validates AI output for correctness, flakiness, and maintainability. Writes clear prompts to generate test cases, test data, edge cases, and bug summaries from requirements or code. Spots hallucinated APIs, weak assertions, and missing coverage in generated tests. Applies the same quality bar to AI-generated and hand-written code.
Applies AI to failure triage and log analysis, flaky-test detection, test selection and prioritization, and test maintenance. 
Help run manual testing on need basis
Able to make consistently good judgment calls on which issues can be self-resolved, and which require escalation
Proficient at balancing multiple efforts simultaneously and meeting strict deadlines
Easily adaptable in a dynamic, constantly evolving, and demanding environment.

Minimum qualifications
BA/BS in Computer Science with 5 + years of professional experience in automation.
3+ years of experience in writing code in Python or Swift or Objective -C to test API and Test Framework like XCUITest and XCTest. Experience with CI integration, test design, and failure triage. AI skills build on this foundation.
4+ years of experience crafting, maintaining and executing test plans. Excellent knowledge of software development lifecycle, testing methodologies, and testing tools
Experience with AI principles, Foundations Models and Evaluations
Familiarity with Gen AI coding tools. Demonstrated ability to use them for design, code generation, and debugging.

Preferred qualifications
Creative thinker and strong problem solver with meticulous attention to detail.
Experience working with complex software stacks with many software and hardware components. Examples: Smartphones, PCs, game engines & consoles, HMDs
Experience with testing Gaming Frameworks and different Game Engines
Experience developing UI automation, preferably in Apple frameworks such as XCTest.
